# Andrew Lensky

> A portfolio of fountain pen expertise, artistic drawings, design projects, and photography by Andrew Lensky, a Kiev-based creative featuring reviews, custom pen designs, inkquarelle artwork, and social commentary.

Andrew Lensky's site showcases a deep passion for fountain pens through detailed reviews and custom modifications, complemented by artistic pursuits in inkquarelle, illustration, and 3D design. The work frequently incorporates social and political themes, particularly related to the Ukraine-Russia war.

## Key Topics

- fountain pens
- fountain pen reviews
- Pilot Falcon
- Bock nibs
- vintage pens
- custom pen design
- inkquarelle
- 3D modeling
- drawings and illustration
- photography
- Ukraine
- design
- handcraft
- Italian pens
- pen modifications

## Fountain Pen Reviews & Collections

- [Dolce Vita](https://lenskiy.org/2023/07/dolce-vita): Review of Italian fountain pens by Maiora, Delta, and Nettuno brands
- [(modern) Stipula Model T with T-Flex](https://lenskiy.org/2026/03/modern-stipula-model-t-with-t-flex): Review of Stipula Model T fountain pen with T-Flex Titanium nib
- [Montblanc Classic (131P)](https://lenskiy.org/2026/02/montblanc-classic-131p): Review and restoration analysis of vintage Montblanc Classic 131P pen
- [Kin Sin 801 (Jin Xing)](https://lenskiy.org/2026/01/kin-sin-801-jin-xing): Review of vintage Chinese Kin Sin 801 pen as Parker 51 clone from 1960s
- [Unsorted fountain pens without full reviews](https://lenskiy.org/2026/01/unsorted-fountain-pens-without-full-reviews): Collection of vintage German and Russian fountain pens with brief notes
- [Some example of some different handwriting by some fountain pen](https://lenskiy.org/2025/10/true-journalism-vs-modern-blogging): Handwriting samples comparing Pilot Falcon, Diamine Matador, and Italic B pens

## Custom Pen Design & Modifications

- [(own) Andrew Lensky "Grandeur Visio" (oversize) + hard case](https://lenskiy.org/2026/02/own-andrew-lensky-grandeur-visio-oversize): Custom Grandeur Visio fountain pen design with Bock #8 nib specifications
- [(own) Bock 380 NU in Sailor KOP body](https://lenskiy.org/2026/03/own-bock-380-nu-in-sailor-kop-body): Custom fountain pen modification combining Bock nib and Sailor KOP body
- [My 10-year-old son's fp kimono for me](https://lenskiy.org/2023/05/my-10-year-old-sons-fp-kimono-for-me): Personal project: handmade fountain pen kimono case crafted by son

## Inkquarelle & Artistic Works

- [Flowing over the mountains (inkquarelle)](https://lenskiy.org/2024/07/flowing-over-the-mountains-inkquarelle): Inkquarelle artwork using Pilot Capless VP and Fabriano paper
- [Door to where? (inkquarelle)](https://lenskiy.org/2024/07/door-to-where-inkquarelle): Philosophical inkquarelle artwork with Ukrainian poetry references
- [(life as) Revolver](https://lenskiy.org/2024/07/life-as-revolver): Graphic design illustration using fountain pens and creative tools

## 3D Design & Digital Projects

- [(own) / [3D Modeling] Andrew Lensky Cycle Pen's Desk Stands](https://lenskiy.org/2025/11/own-3d-modeling-andrew-lensky-cycle-pens-desk-stands): 3D designed desk stands for fountain pen organization and display

## Social Commentary & Photography

- [866th day of WAR in Ukraine #stoprussia](https://lenskiy.org/2024/07/866th-day-of-war-in-ukraine-stoprussia): Political activism art documenting Ukraine war and Okhmatdyt hospital impact
